Love the Loop (SMBC multi-speed Saturday)

Sarasota, FL · Myakka · Road

Love the Loop (SMBC multi-speed Saturday) is a road group ride in Sarasota, FL. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Old Miakka Church. About 30 miles, 14-16 mph (about 30 miles, single-file paceline, limited rotation) and 16-18 mph (about 34 miles, rotating single-file paceline).

For visitors

SMBC ride pages say non-members are welcome and ask riders to sign the waiver sheet at the start. Riders are asked to bring a non-perishable food item or a cash donation for the church food pantry.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14-16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Love the Loop (SMBC multi-speed Saturday) group ride

Saturday multi-speed ride on the country roads east of Sarasota, from Old Miakka Church. Two pace groups share the loop through Myakka City, with a rest stop at the community park. Food for the church pantry is the entry fee.
